description: This file defines the class ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategy, which implements substitution logic for policy entries within modify commands, specifically handling placeholders related to SubjectId in ModifyPolicyEntry objects.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy to provide substitution logic specifically for ModifyPolicyEntry objects, replacing placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class by specifying the type it handles, which is ModifyPolicyEntry.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs substitution on the given ModifyPolicyEntry instance using the provided substitution algorithm, returning a possibly updated modify policy entry wrapped in WithDittoHeaders.
